description: Sanctioned repairs to published release bytes. released-version-hashes.json records what was published; this file records a reviewed correction when a later commit edited a released file without re-publishing it. Every repair names both digests and a reason so the change is reviewable. The indexer accepts the repaired digest for that exact path and refuses any later drift.

repairs.reason: The released file was edited by a later commit that did not update the tracked digest. 2.1.6 and 2.1.7 were published from this content, so the current bytes are the ones every consumer builds against. Repaired rather than re-hashed silently; the original published digest is preserved here.
